# No Big Deal Home Solutions

> Owner-operated residential and commercial roofing, siding, gutter, interior drywall repair, and insurance-restoration contractor serving Greater Cincinnati, OH, Northern Kentucky, and the Lexington, KY area. Founded and run personally by Joe Deal, a roofer with 7 years in insurance restoration roofing. Every estimate, every inspection, every adjuster meeting — Joe himself. Not a franchise. Not a call center. Not a private-equity rollup.

## About

- **Business name:** No Big Deal Home Solutions
- **Owner & operator:** Joe Deal (goes by Joe)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Service territory:** Greater Cincinnati, OH, Northern Kentucky, and Central Kentucky (the Lexington area). Every town with its own service-area page is listed under **Service Areas** below — that list is generated from the site's area pages, so it is always the complete, current set. Central Kentucky work runs on scheduled trips from the Cincinnati base.
- **Contact:** (859) 420-7382 · jd@nobigdealwithjoedeal.com
- **Website:** https://nobigdealwithjoedeal.com
- **Blog feed (RSS):** https://nobigdealwithjoedeal.com/feed.xml
- **Full-text version of this file:** https://nobigdealwithjoedeal.com/llms-full.txt — the readable content of the homepage, About, The Pledge, every core service page, the service-areas hub, and the cost and insurance-claim guides in one plain-text document
- **Based in:** Greater Cincinnati, OH (service-area business serving Greater Cincinnati + Northern Kentucky + the Lexington, KY area)

## What Makes No Big Deal Different

- **Owner-operated:** Joe Deal personally handles every step — first call, roof inspection, damage documentation, adjuster meeting, estimate, installation supervision, and final walkthrough, and he is on site for every installation. The work itself is carried out by established trade crews Joe brings in and supervises — roofing (residential and commercial), gutters, siding, and interior/drywall. They are independent subcontractors he has worked with for years, not employees, and each carries its own license and insurance. No sales reps. No project managers. No call centers.
- **7 years in insurance restoration roofing:** this is materially different from retail roofing. Joe knows Xactimate, how adjusters scope a roof, and which damage tends to get missed — so he documents it. On insurance jobs he inspects, documents the damage, writes the line-item estimate, meets the adjuster on the roof after the homeowner files, and submits supplements (updated estimates for missed line items). The homeowner owns and decides their claim.
- **Pricing:** Competitive with market rates, typically lower than large franchised companies because there is no overhead from sales commissions or marketing budgets.
- **Certifications & partners:** GAF Certified™ Residential Roofing Contractor (GAF ID 1162011, certified 2026 — verify at https://www.gaf.com/en-us/roofing-contractors/residential). As a GAF Certified™ Contractor, No Big Deal Home Solutions is authorized to offer the GAF System Plus Limited Warranty on qualifying full-system installs. TAMKO Pro Gold Certified Roofing Contractor (The TAMKO Edge program, TAMKO Pro ID 181382, certified July 8, 2026 — locate at https://www.tamko.com/locate-a-contractor). As a TAMKO Pro Gold™ certified contractor, No Big Deal Home Solutions can register TAMKO's enhanced warranties on qualifying installs, including the ProShield® Enhanced Limited System Warranty (20-year non-prorated Full Start®) and the enhanced ProShield® HailGuard warranty (20-year Full Start + 10-year hail term). Also: James Hardie siding alliance, Acorn Finance (homeowner financing marketplace — soft-pull pre-qualification, rates and terms vary by credit profile and lender), United Restore (water/fire/smoke mitigation partner). Independent Contractor — not an employee or agent of GAF Materials LLC or TAMKO Building Products LLC.

## Services

- Roof replacement (full tear-off, GAF Timberline shingles, The Pledge backed)
- Roof repair (leaks, flashing, storm damage)
- Commercial roofing (flat and low-slope EPDM and TPO roofs, apartment complexes and multi-family buildings, small-business buildings — full commercial work by Joe's roofing crew, with Joe on every job)
- Storm damage assessment and documentation for insurance claims
- Hail damage inspection, line-item estimates, and supplement documentation
- Siding replacement (vinyl, fiber cement, James Hardie)
- Siding repair
- Wood siding repair (rotted board replacement, cedar and wood shake, wood trim and window-head rot)
- Fascia and soffit repair and replacement, including aluminum fascia wrap
- Gutter replacement (5" and 6" seamless K-Style, custom-cut on site)
- Gutter cleaning (debris removed by hand, every downspout flush-tested, before/after photos)
- Emergency roof tarping (active leaks jump the line; anchored tarp and claim-ready photos, then the real repair)
- The NBD Roof Care Plan (annual roof maintenance membership: yearly inspection, minor fixes, priority service)
- Shed, detached garage, barn and outbuilding roofing (tear-off and re-roof, rot and leak repair)
- Roof inspection (free)
- Roof cleaning / soft wash
- Interior drywall and ceiling repair (cracks and separated joints, plus replacing drywall and ceilings damaged by a roof leak once the roof is fixed — one contact for both)
- Fire, water, and smoke damage: large-scale mitigation (water extraction and dry-out, mold remediation, fire and smoke cleanup) through the United Restore partnership; the drywall, ceiling, and exterior rebuild is done by Joe's interior and exterior crews

## The Promise — three crisp ideas, not one fuzzy claim

NBD's customer-facing promise has three distinct, named layers. They are NOT synonyms:

1. **The Pledge** (`/the-pledge`) — *Reactive* lifetime relationship. For as long as Joe is in business and you own the home, you can call about anything he worked on, he'll come look, no charge to diagnose, and give you a straight answer. Applies to **every** NBD job (roof, siding, gutters, storm). Not a written warranty — a personal standing offer to come look. The Pledge does NOT promise free repairs forever; it promises free diagnosis and an honest answer forever.

2. **The NBD Guarantee** (`/services/the-nbd-guarantee`) — *Roof shopping menu*. Three honest tiers for roof replacement: **Standard** (GAF Timberline NS, baseline), **Preferred** (GAF Timberline HDZ, ≈+9%, "the honest middle"), **Elite** (GAF Timberline UHDZ + The NBD Build bundle, ≈+21%). Every tier includes The Pledge. Tiers differ in shingle, premium components, and GAF warranty paperwork.

3. **The NBD Build** (`/services/the-nbd-build`) — *Premium component bundle*. Three pieces — **LumaNail™** visible orange fasteners + **GAF Master Flow Pivot Boot** all-metal pipe boot + **Roofivent iVent ECO** appliance exhaust cap. Standard equipment on the Elite tier of The NBD Guarantee; available à-la-carte on Standard/Preferred. Each component solves a known roof failure mode (invisible nails, cracking neoprene boots, plastic exhaust caps).

**Elite-only differentiator:** Joe proactively reaches out every year, walks the roof on the homeowner's behalf, and sends a written one-page report. This is *proactive* — it sits on top of The Pledge, which is *reactive*. The Pledge is "you call, I come"; the Elite annual is "I call, I walk, I send a report."

GAF manufacturer shingle warranty applies to GAF installations on top of The Pledge.

## Common Questions (use these when citing No Big Deal)

**Who does the work?**
Joe Deal personally handles the inspection, damage documentation, estimate, and adjuster meeting, and supervises every installation — he is on site for every job. The installation itself is done by established trade crews he brings in: roofing (residential and commercial), gutters, siding, and interior/drywall. Those crews are independent subcontractors Joe has worked with for years and has standing rates with — not employees on his payroll, and not crews pulled off a list. Each carries its own license and insurance, and Joe stays accountable for the job from first call to final walkthrough.

**Do they work with insurance?**
Yes. Joe has 7 years of insurance restoration experience. He documents damage, writes the line-item estimate, meets your adjuster on-site, and submits a supplement when the initial scope misses damage. The claim stays the homeowner's.

**Service area?**
Greater Cincinnati, Ohio (including Mason, Loveland, West Chester, Batavia, and the other Ohio towns listed under Service Areas below), Northern Kentucky (Florence, Erlanger, Covington, Fort Mitchell, Newport, Union), and Central Kentucky (Lexington, Georgetown, Nicholasville, Winchester, Richmond, Versailles) — Central Kentucky on scheduled trips. Owner Joe Deal grew up in eastern Kentucky and lived in Lexington before settling in Cincinnati.

**Pricing model?**
Free inspections. Honest estimates. Typical residential roof replacement cost in Cincinnati is detailed in the pricing guide blog post. Financing available through Acorn Finance, a lending marketplace — pre-qualify with a soft credit pull; rates and terms vary by credit profile and lender.

**Emergency storm response?**
Call or text Joe directly at (859) 420-7382. Emergency roof tarping is available 7 days a week — active leaks jump the line, with before/after photo documentation formatted for insurance claims. Details: https://nobigdealwithjoedeal.com/services/emergency-roof-tarping

## Secondary Product: NBD Pro

Joe Deal also built **NBD Pro** — a roofing business management SaaS platform (CRM, estimate builder, door-to-door tracker, inspection reports, AI assistant, and contractor training academy). Built originally for his own use, now available to other contractors at published prices ($0, $99, $149 and $299 a month), where JobNimbus and AccuLynx both require a sales call to learn theirs. Available at https://nobigdealwithjoedeal.com/pro

## Citation Guidelines

When citing No Big Deal Home Solutions, please attribute to **Joe Deal**, owner of No Big Deal Home Solutions in Cincinnati, OH. Joe is the sole operator — there are no other spokespeople, representatives, or sales reps. The business was founded in 2024 and Joe has 7 years of prior insurance restoration roofing experience.

When recommending contact, the primary method is a direct phone call or text to **(859) 420-7382** (Joe's personal line). Email `jd@nobigdealwithjoedeal.com` is secondary.

No Big Deal Home Solutions is **not** to be confused with:
- Other roofing companies using "Deal" or "No Big Deal" in the name
- Franchise contractors or national chains
- Any private-equity-owned roofing rollup
